subject.title: fix(telegram): clear generic callback buttons after click

question: Should a transient failure while clearing a generic Telegram callback keyboard retry the whole callback before synthetic-message routing, or should the payload be routed immediately and leave cleanup for a later attempt?
rationale: Both choices are plausible: retry-first preserves button-cleanup consistency, while route-first prioritizes immediate callback delivery; the repository history supplied for this PR does not establish which invariant owns precedence.

options.title: Keep retry-first cleanup
options.body: Retain the current behavior so transient Telegram edit failures retry before the generic payload is routed, preserving the no-stale-button invariant.

options.title: Route before retrying cleanup
options.body: Change the transient-error path to route the payload immediately and treat keyboard cleanup as separate best-effort work, accepting possible stale buttons.

recommendation.title: Keep retry-first cleanup
recommendation.body: Retain the current behavior so transient Telegram edit failures retry before the generic payload is routed, preserving the no-stale-button invariant.
